visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a blue denim shirt and a black baseball cap sits at a desk with a professional studio microphone. He holds a gray smartphone and speaks enthusiastically. The background features a glowing blue digital holographic interface with 'AI' text and circuit patterns. (2) The scene transitions to a white screen with a Google search bar, followed by a product showcase of the Google Pixel 10 Pro on a black background. (3) A young man in a white t-shirt poses for a photo. A smartphone screen is shown in the foreground using the 'Add Me' feature to merge multiple people into one shot. (4) A handheld shot of a smartphone shows Gemini Live identifying ingredients on a kitchen counter: onions, tomatoes, broccoli, and sweet potatoes. Text advice appears on the phone screen. (5) The man in the denim shirt returns to the studio, demonstrating photography advice features. A phone screen displays an older man and a baby, with UI overlays suggesting camera angle adjustments. (6) The man gives a voice command to the phone. The screen transitions to a high-quality 3D animation of a boy in a blue cap extending a tape measure across a city and into a galaxy. (7) The man stands outdoors in front of a Taiwan Mobile retail store with a large geometric colorful logo. He points towards the store while promotional graphics for the phone appear as overlays. (8) Final studio shot where the man holds up the phone and its charging accessories, concluding the presentation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for the Google Pixel 10 Pro and its partnership with Taiwan Mobile. It highlights advanced AI-driven features such as 'Add Me' for group photos, 'Gemini Live' for lifestyle assistance, and AI video generation to appeal to tech-savvy consumers looking for a smarter mobile experience.
